title: Symmetric Polynomial Identity: (∑xᵢ)² = ∑xᵢ² + 2·e₂ via elemSymm Recurrence

problemStatement.formal: (∑ i : Fin n, x i) ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ 2 + 2 * elemSymm 2 x
problemStatement.plain: The square of the sum of variables equals the sum of their squares plus twice the second elementary symmetric polynomial.

currentState.focus: Already proved in AmgmInequalityOQ02Defs.lean as sq_sum_eq_sum_sq_add_two_elemSymm

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Already formalized as sq_sum_eq_sum_sq_add_two_elemSymm in AmgmInequalityOQ02Defs.lean:195. Proved by induction on n using elemSymm recurrence. 0 sorries, 0 axioms.
builtItems: Also used in maclaurin_sq_m1_ge_m2_general for the Maclaurin inequality M₁ ≥ M₂
insights: Proof uses elemSymm_two_succ recurrence: e₂(x₀,...,xₙ) = e₂(x₀,...,xₙ₋₁) + xₙ·e₁(x₀,...,xₙ₋₁)
The inductive step closes via nlinarith with sq_nonneg hints
